catalog.name: Lagoon Nebula
catalog.description: The Lagoon is a star-forming H II region about 1,326 parsecs away. Its young NGC 6530 cluster shares the surrounding cloud complex.

facts.label: Distance from the Sun
facts.note: Adopted Gaia DR2 cluster distance from Wright et al. (2019), section 3.4: 1326 −69/+77 pc, including the stated parallax zero-point correction and systematic uncertainty. It is not an individual gas-cloud depth measurement.

source.label: Wright et al. (2019), The Gaia-ESO Survey: Asymmetric expansion of the Lagoon Nebula cluster NGC 6530 from GES and Gaia DR2
